tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Every public YesTechie agent endpoint with URL, methods, auth and size. Use when you are unsure which tool fits; start here. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/site)

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: Company description, founders, office, contact and credentials. Use when the person asks who YesTechie is or whether it is licensed. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/about)

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Published founders (list), or one founder in full with idOrSlug. Use when the person asks who runs YesTechie. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/team[/{idOrSlug}])

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Office address, phone and email. Use when the person wants to reach YesTechie themselves. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/contact-info)

tools.name: get_join_our_team

tools.name: list_pages

tools.name: get_clients
tools.description: Client logos, map count, deployments by state and city. Use when the person asks who YesTechie has worked for. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/clients)

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Check whether YesTechie serves a location: California HQ, deployments by state and city, travel policy. Use when the person asks if YesTechie works in their area, or before quoting a site outside California. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/coverage)

tools.name: list_services

Lean list (id, slug, url, title, summary, date; page/limit/fields/detail), or one item in full with idOrSlug. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/services[/{idOrSlug}])

tools.description: One YesTechie service in full: what is included and how it is delivered. Use when the person asks about a specific service (find it with list_services). (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/services/{idOrSlug})

tools.description: One published yestechie.com page as plain text with its canonical URL. Use when you need the full text of a page to cite (find the slug with list_pages). (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/pages/{slug})

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Catalog list prices (USD, pre-tax, before scope): equipment (MSRP) or labor (standard rates). Use when the person asks what one item or labor task costs; use unifi_estimate for a whole project. (REST: GET /api/agent/v0/pricing/{equipment|labor})

tools.name: submit_contact
tools.description: Request a site survey or callback. Attach quoteRef. Use when the person explicitly asks to be contacted and has supplied name and email or phone; it sends a real email. 3 per IP and 2 per email per day. (REST: POST /api/agent/v0/contact)

tools.name: submit_join_application
tools.description: Apply to join the team, exactly like the /join-our-team form. Use when the person asks to apply. Sends real email to YesTechie and a confirmation to the sender: call only when the person asked you to. 3 per IP and 2 per email per day. (REST: POST /api/agent/v0/join-our-team)

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_about" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_site_info, get_contact_info, get_join_our_team, list_pages, list_services, list_projects, list_articles, get_page · Private data: get_about, get_contact_info, submit_contact · Public sink: get_contact_info, get_join_our_team, unifi_estimate, submit_contact, submit_join_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_site_info, get_contact_info, get_join_our_team, list_pages, list_services, list_projects, list_articles, get_page · Private data: get_about, get_contact_info, submit_contact · Public sink: get_contact_info, get_join_our_team, unifi_estimate, submit_contact, submit_join_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
